review: GLM corrected-scope review, before any of the16 main trials

items.evidence: WitnessSpec.observe fingerprints only observed compiler files; optional set membership does not add inputs. Four actual main witness readbacks contain no test output watches. Full snapshot correctly includes test graph outputs.
JDK17/21 compiler lib/modules is required, never made optional by this fix. JDK8 compiler capture is not claimed.
ContentFingerprint.put hashes each UTF8 value with a four-byte byte-length prefix before contents.
JVM/Kotlin method names cannot contain dot. Actual Kotlin2.0.10 probe rejects a.b and all four source inventories contain zero dotted function names.
Removed source lines include a function start/signature; insertions before another declaration remain distinct. Two regressions added. All four oracle documents stayed byte-identical.
Local functions and local-class methods are outside current source-alias mapping; no current primary oracle declaration has that form. Non-mapping is not proof of compiler generation.
Actual Kotlin2.0.10 module-name eval-public emits value$eval_public; only known kotlin_module suffix plus owner/arity/line is accepted.
Protocol requires per-case interpretation and separates test-suite discovery from call-graph anchors; no single aggregate impact-detection claim.
Exact allowed fence grammar stated; invalid error breakdowns reported per arm.
Invalid response format does not abort trials. An actual dispatcher unit test records invalid then valid responses and completes; only infrastructure/input integrity failures stop.
Primary and non-primary coverage remain separate; oracle agreement not false-positive precision.
Frozen transport.SYSTEM is read-only safety/source-evidence guidance, with no oracle/output semantics; v5 appends the same JSON-only instruction in both arms.
